aggregation: convKRms[p] is the root mean square over the 512 channels of convolution K's output (after its GELU) at position p. attention[l, h, i, j] is layer l head h's attention from the frames of bin i (mean over them) to the frames of bin j (summed), bins of 20 frames (0.4 s), the last one shorter; every row sums to 1. attentionDistance is the mean over query frames of Σ_j a_ij |i − j| in ms. similarity[m, k] is the cosine similarity between masked frame maskedFrames[m]'s context vector and candidate k (k = 0 the true quantized target, then the targets of frames negatives[m, k − 1]); blocked marks distractors whose target equals the true one, which the loss leaves out (stored as 0). Logits are similarity / temperature. beam.steps[t] is the beam after frame t: [prefix index, log p_blank, log p_letter] (null: no path of that kind), likeliest first; beam.final[].exact is log p of that text summed over every alignment (CTC forward).
